notes.title: Cosmetics Update - Early Access v0.8
notes.notes:
[h2]Cosmetics Update[/h2]
I'm sorry it took so long, but here it is!

[h3]Item Types[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skin
[*] Hats
[*] Hair
[*] Face
[*] Chest
[*] Legs
[*] Feet
[/list]
[h3]Item Drops (might change later)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][Common][/b] Every Day!
[*] [b][Rare][/b] Every 5 days!
[*] [b][Legendary][/b] Every week!
[/list]
[b]Note: You need to play to get items![/b]


[h3]Weekly Voted Item[/h3]
For the next couple of weeks I will add some items that are voted on in the Discord server.
If you would like to vote: https://discord.gg/hUbzJCDXD2.


[h3]Item Store[/h3]
It is possible to buy items in the item store (if you would like to support me).

[b]Note: If you have bought a new item, you might need to restart the game to unlock it![/b]
